primary_originals.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
primary_originals.excerpt: This is achieved by deconstructing the original rotary embedding into three components: temporal, height, and width.
primary_originals.inspection: Read the full original §2.2. Images use constant temporal IDs and distinct height/width IDs; video temporal IDs follow actual frame times at 40ms per ID; audio uses identical component position IDs. The lesson explicitly uses a different toy convention (250ms and zero spatial audio coordinates), so it does not claim equivalence to the official implementation.

primary_originals.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
primary_originals.locator: §2.3 Perceivation, Video and Multimodal Position Embedding (TM-RoPE)
primary_originals.excerpt: Specifically, the temporal, height, and width dimensions are interleaved and assigned 24, 20, and 20 rotary angles, respectively.
primary_originals.inspection: Read the full original §2.3. The paper states the 24/20/20 interleaving directly, uses row and column positions for visual height/width, and uses 80ms per temporal ID. Its performance rationale is not treated as an empirical result of the toy lesson.

primary_originals.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
primary_originals.excerpt: In order to generalize our results in 2D to any xi ∈ Rd where d is even, we divide the d-dimension space into d/2 sub-spaces
primary_originals.inspection: Read the original formulae and surrounding text through pdftotext -layout: 2D rotation is [[cos,-sin],[sin,cos]], even-dimensional space is split into independent 2D blocks, and the rotated inner product depends on relative coordinates. Eq.(34) gives the equivalent pairwise arithmetic. Also inspected §4.5.5 limitations; no training claim is imported into this review.

primary_originals.title: Attention Is All You Need
primary_originals.locator: §3.1 Decoder; §3.2.3 Applications of Attention in our Model, third bullet
primary_originals.excerpt: self-attention layers in the decoder allow each position in the decoder to attend to all positions in the decoder up to and including that position.
primary_originals.inspection: Read the original decoder masking passages. The standard mask describes sequence positions up to and including the query. It does not assert chronological causality of physical audiovisual timestamps; the latter depends on serialization and is explicitly excluded by this lesson.
